long_description:
This class is held weekly, on Mondays from 10:30am-11:30am, all school year long. It's for girls and boys of all ages, 5 and up! The Class List with names/genders/ages of students registered up for these classes are found at the bottom of the event's description.

We will be going through a new yoga routine each week while learning many yoga moves! Whether you're' a yoga pro, and maybe you've never done yoga before, this class is for you. If you like to join us in this fun, we'd love to see you and make new friends!

*The only thing you'll need is a yoga mat, and I suggest a small hand towel to wipe the sweat off your face, if needed. Also, please wear flexible clothing that can be moved in.

Here's the schedule for the rest of the semester:

October/November's Calendar Lessons:
10/1210/1910/2611/2 - TECH WEEK - NO SCHOOL11/9Cost: $40 per student for these 4 classes.
Payment Due: OCTOBER 1st, 2026 @ 3:00pm

November/December's Calendar Lessons:
11/1611/23 - THANKSGIVING BREAK - NO SCHOOL11/3012/7 - LAST CLASS FOR THE SEMESTERCost: $30 per student for these 3 classes.
Payment Due: NOVEMBER 1st, 2026 @ 3:00pm

*Invoices will be sent out round the 15th of each month that will be due on the first of each month. It's assumed that you'd like to continue each month unless you let us know that you no longer will. No judgements, just let us know ASAP as there may be a waiting list for the class.

We'll be outside under a huge pavilion so prepare yourself for the day's weather. Bring enough water, bug spray, blankets, coat, personal battery operated fans, cool clothing, etc. Please check our FB Page to see if any updates have been made about the classes each day. ALL announcement will be via FB as I can't access the website via phone. If you're planning on dropping off your child please contact Kei Denevan our Head Organizer first to get approval.
